itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter8_verse2.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 8 Verse 2
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter8_verse2.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 8 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter8_verse2.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 8, Verse 2 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter8_verse2.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
